data.name: Pralhad
data.gender_notes: Pralhad is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Pralhad means 'one who holds a lotus in his heart'. This name is derived from Sanskrit words 'pral' which means 'holding' and 'hada' which means 'lotus'. The name Pralhad carries the meaning “Holder of the lotus” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Pralhad usually hope their child will grow to embody holder of the lotus and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Pralhad is a sacred name in Hinduism and is believed to bring blessings of devotion, loyalty and strength. It is a name of Lord Vishnu, who is the preserver of the universe in Hinduism.
data.etymology: Pralhad belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Holder of the lotus.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Pralhad total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

data.cultural_impact: Pralhad is a popular name in Hindu culture, especially in Indian subcontinent. It holds a significant place in Indian mythology as the name of a renowned character in the epic Ramayana. Pralhad was a great devotee of Lord Vishnu and his unwavering faith was a testament to his unwavering devotion towards the deity.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Pralhad signifies the inner depth and purity of an individual. It symbolizes a devotional soul who deeply cherishes the love and devotion towards the divine. The lotus symbolizes purity, peace, and calmness. By holding a lotus in his heart, Pralhad represents an individual who nurtures inner peace and purity, and remains undisturbed by the external world. The name serves as a constant reminder to remain steadfast in one's faith, no matter what the circumstances may be.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Pralhad, meaning 'the one who pleases Lord Vishnu', embodies unwavering devotion and surrender to divine will. His name symbolizes the purity and innocence of a devoted heart, constantly seeking the blessings and protection of the supreme being.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Pralhad is a character in the Indian epic Ramayana. The name Pralhad carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Pralhad is a devotee of Lord Vishnu and is known for his unwavering devotion and purity of heart.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Pralhad remains relevant in modern Hindu society, representing a bridge between traditional Vedic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Hindu names.
